purpose: Update 19B corrects audit-harness/evidence defects found by the first full Update 19 CI run. It changes no production semantics and does not reinterpret any production mismatch as a pass.
diagnosis: Arithmetic negative-year probes used plain objects instead of the public date-class contract.
Chinese object comparison was property-order-sensitive and incorrectly treated non-normative relatedYear as part of the normative structured value.
Browser audit attempted JSON.stringify on BigInt before parity checks.
The direct scroll 149 phrase matcher used the wrong Hebrew wording.
Historical Update-8 Stage-6 compared absolute identity IDs across separately instrumented imports; Update19 now uses a fresh same-runtime 1/10/100/1000/5000 failure-state probe.
Adding Update19 oracle/corpus audit files legitimately changed the deterministic Update16 authority inventory, so its evidence artifact is regenerated before checksum verification.
Historical Update15 crypto SKIP is not accepted as final evidence; Update19 runs fresh math/crypto profiles and faults directly.
